from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Captures cash flow metrics for a single company from one filing."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (YYYY-MM)")
    operating_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net cash provided by or used in operating activities; negative indicates 'used'")
    investing_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net cash provided by or used in investing activities; negative indicates 'used'")
    net_cash_change: float = Field(description="Net change in cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash; positive indicates 'increase'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level parse class aggregating all extracted company cash flow records."""
    cash_flow_records: list[CompanyCashFlow]
